g.text: Help Metadata Detail - Supplement to the Global Command Diagram
Save and reload useCases in agent.json.
Read and publication share the Agent lock.
Exactly three business fields; absent text is [].
No command discriminator or internal receipt.
No prompt, bindings, or runtime objects.
This is a Help-only detail view, not the global Command structure.
Help uses authored Agent metadata, not the command catalog.
No model/tool call, implicit refresh, Session Entry or execution lease.
CommandExecutionContext retains the common request catalog.
DTOs belong to runtimeapi.dto.command; VOs to runtimeapi.vo.
All shown Help classes and relations are implemented at the source baseline.
